full_judgment: 11. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the present case as contained in the complaint petition itself and the admitted business transaction between the parties, the opposite party being the manufacturer and the petitioner being the principal sales agent since 1950 and their continued transaction up to filing of the Criminal case it is found that the petitioner had no initial intention to cheat-while taking delivery of goods by issuing that postdated cheques only at the insistence of the opposite party and thus no ingredient of section 420 Is found to exist even upon the facts as stated in the complaint petition.
